data.long_meaning: The name Sharvitaan is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘sharva’ meaning ‘wisdom’ and ‘it’ meaning ‘goddess’. Sharvitaan is a name for the goddess of wisdom and prosperity. This name is believed to bring blessings of knowledge, wisdom, and wealth. The name Sharvitaan carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharvitaan usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
